question: How should the six limbs be ritually placed on the body in this practice?
premises: The six limbs are to be placed.
Placement is done by double repetition.
The locations begin with the thumbs.
inference: One should place the six limbs on the thumbs and so on by double repetition.
plain_english: By repeating twice, one should place the six limbs on the thumbs and the other parts.
